averaging: macro across products: mortgage contributes 75 cases to education's 20, so a pooled mean would be a mortgage score

judge.caveat: The judge and the system under test are the same model family, so a shared blind spot would not show up here. Every judged figure has a deterministic counterpart in this report; where they disagree, trust the deterministic one.
judge.sampling_note: The deterministic metrics cover every case. The judged metrics cover a balanced sample, taken per product so neither dominates; judged_cases states the denominator for each.

metric_notes.directional_agreement: positive / neutral / negative agreement, a softer test
metric_notes.judge_hallucination_rate: 1 - score, so 0.0 is the good end
metric_notes.narrative_faithfulness_deterministic: Re-derived by scripts/recheck_faithfulness.py after a fix to the checker's supported-set, which had been flagging the model for quoting figures the system computed and supplied. The figure the run itself produced is kept beside it as narrative_faithfulness_deterministic_as_measured. It is a conservative lower bound; see reports/faithfulness_recheck.json.
metric_notes.outcome_accuracy: exact outcome-family match, over cases whose expected outcome the system can express at all. Read it against rule_coverage: 40% of mortgage cases turn on a rule family the engine does not implement, which is the ceiling on this figure rather than an excuse for it
metric_notes.outcome_accuracy_all_cases: the same match over every case, including the 6 expecting APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS, which the recommendation node cannot emit and therefore always misses

implemented_families.EDU-INC: src/rules.py — debt-to-income capacity and residual income

implemented_families.AST-RSV: src/rules.py — minimum reserves, measured after the funds-to-close draw
implemented_families.CRD-SCR: src/rules.py — minimum representative score, graduated by leverage in v2.0
implemented_families.DTI-CONV: src/rules.py — affordability ceiling, with the compensating-factor extension
implemented_families.SEC-INJ: src/guardrails/ + supervisor_node — injection detection and quarantine
implemented_families.UWR-HRV: src/review_triggers.py — the mandatory human-review routing table

rule_coverage.note: Rules in the unimplemented families are still retrieved, cited and shown to the reader — the retrieval subsystem covers both corpora in full. What is missing is code evaluating them against a threshold, so a case whose golden outcome turns on one cannot be scored correct except by coincidence. This is the ceiling on outcome_accuracy and the first thing to extend.

system_under_test.llm_role: narrative rationale only; no retrieval, arithmetic, threshold or verdict is produced by a model
